title: A good Mirecourt Violin, circa 1910, labelled H. Clotelle Lutherie Artistique, L.O.B. 14³/16in. (360mm), in case. The two-piece back of medium flame, the ribs and scroll of similar curl, the table of medium grain, the transparent varnish of a brown colour. Minus tailpiece.

The one-piece back, ribs and scroll almost plain, the one-piece table with integral bass bar of open broad grain, varnish of a transparent red-brown colour. A Bavarian Viola, circa 1870, L.O.B. 15¼in. (387mm). The one-piece back, ribs and scroll of narrow curl, table of medium grain, varnish of a yellow-brown colour. Varnish rubbed down.
